scenario: `emit` giving every non-nullable slot of a `logical` schema a value (LGRA.13.11) compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. Named for IDSP.3 (libds's emit dispatch, an I clause a compiler-class vector cannot count for).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Local scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: String mutable

rule r:
    Trig
->
    emit Local logical a: 1 b: "x"
